email_subject: Application - Technical Customer Success Manager at Paperbox
email_body:
Dear Paperbox team,

I'm applying for the Technical Customer Success Manager role. Your mission to reduce friction in insurance operations through AI agents resonates with me — I've seen how manual, admin-heavy processes slow down service, and I'd love to help insurers and brokers get more from your product.

My background combines technical implementation and customer-facing work. At Knowledge Experts, I helped build SharePoint-based digital workplaces for large clients like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, translating business needs into working solutions. As a freelancer, I configure WordPress environments, implement structured data, and use AI tools daily to automate repetitive tasks. I also have front-end development experience, which helps me understand and explain technical concepts clearly.

I'm fluent in English, a native Turkish speaker, and have working knowledge of Dutch. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, close to Ghent, and excited about the opportunity to support your customers and contribute to Paperbox's scale-up phase.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can add value to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Paperbox team,

I'm writing to apply for the Technical Customer Success Manager position. What draws me to Paperbox is the clear focus on solving a real, tangible problem: the manual, admin-heavy mailroom processes that slow down insurers and brokers. Your Agentic AI solution brings structure and efficiency to an industry that desperately needs it, and I want to be part of making that happen for your 75+ customers.

My experience sits at the intersection of technical implementation and customer interaction. At Knowledge Experts, I supported the team in building SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for major clients like ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores) and Aras Kargo (12,000 staff). This involved understanding client workflows, configuring systems, and ensuring the end result worked for the people using it. As a freelancer, I design and build WordPress sites, implement structured data and technical SEO, and use AI tools daily to automate repetitive tasks — skills that map directly to configuring customer environments and translating requirements into technical specifications.

I also bring front-end development experience from ViviDoctor, where I built and optimized features for a healthcare web application. This technical foundation helps me communicate effectively with engineering teams and explain complex ideas in simple terms. I'm fluent in English, a native Turkish speaker, and have working knowledge of Dutch, which I'm continuing to improve.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, close to Ghent, and excited about the opportunity to work in a flexible, scale-up environment. I'm eager to learn more about your product and contribute to your customers' success.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
